scenes.narration_line: It is 3:07 AM. Your bedroom is completely silent.
scenes.visual_notes: Wide moody bedroom at night, glowing 3:07 AM alarm clock on nightstand, warm editorial ink-and-watercolor style.

scenes.narration_line: Nobody called you. Nothing bumped the window. Yet your eyes snap wide open.
scenes.visual_notes: Close-up of protagonist awake in bed staring at ceiling, subtle cool midnight blue wash contrasting warm charcoal linework.
